name: Cabo Verde

fees.name: Tourist visa, single entry (Embassy of Cabo Verde, Washington DC)
fees.validity: Stay up to 90 days (extendable once); must be used within 180 days of issue
fees.notes: Embassy sticker-visa fee published by the Cabo Verde Embassy in the USA; fee is the same schedule used for tourist and temporary categories (money order, cash or bank check).

fees.name: Tourist/temporary visa, multiple entry (Embassy of Cabo Verde, Washington DC)
fees.validity: Multiple entries; temporary multiple-entry allows total stay of 90 days within one year of issue
fees.notes: Multiple-entry rate from the same embassy fee schedule.

fees.name: Visa on arrival (border/SEF, added via EASE pre-registration)
fees.notes: A visa can be added during EASE pre-registration or obtained on arrival. Third-party sources report roughly EUR 25 (approx. 2,750 CVE), but no official published amount was verifiable, so amount is null. Note: from 1 January 2026 nationals of certain listed countries must obtain a visa BEFORE arrival (VOA no longer available to them), per notice on ease.gov.cv.

fees.name: EASE pre-registration + Airport Security Tax (TSA), international flights
fees.applies: all foreign visitors (exemptions: children under 2, transit/transfer passengers, Cabo Verdean nationals, resident foreigners)
fees.notes: Mandatory pre-registration on www.ease.gov.cv up to 5 days before travel and payment of the TSA of 3,400 CVE (approx. EUR 30.83 / USD 35). Not a visa, but required of visa-exempt travellers too; can also be paid on arrival. Domestic inter-island flights: 150 CVE.

fees.name: Transit visa
fees.notes: Transit visa category exists per the MFA consular portal, but no specific published fee was found; embassy fee schedule (USD 60 single / 114 multiple) likely applies but is not explicitly stated for transit.

fees.name: Temporary visa (business, cultural, medical, family visit)
fees.validity: Single entry: stay up to 180 days; multiple entry (USD 114): 90 days total within one year
fees.notes: Business travel falls under the 'temporary' visa category; embassy schedule lists USD 60 single entry / USD 114 multiple entries.

vfs.note: No outsourced centre (VFS/TLS/BLS) for inbound Cabo Verde visas; applications go through the EASE portal, embassies/consulates, or on arrival. The VFS Global centre in Praia handles outbound Portugal/Schengen visas only.

free_visa_notes: Since 1 January 2019, nationals of the EU/EEA, UK, Switzerland and most African countries are visa-exempt for stays up to 30 days; they must still pre-register on EASE and pay the 3,400 CVE Airport Security Tax (TSA). From 1 January 2026, a list of nationalities announced on ease.gov.cv must obtain a visa prior to arrival.
